findings.reason: the first done-when bullet asserts the refusal names the rule, so a node implementing the plan exactly as written fails its own test and must invent a message-composition point the plan does not specify.
findings.text: §4 requires "The refusal names the rule, that additional work is a section or a prompt, and quotes the offending fragment", but the mechanism it names is the shared predicate carrying one more reason ("The predicate returns the offending fragment, and each path raises it in its own channel"), and the refuser it reuses composes its message as `f"{subject} must not contain {forged}"` (reckon/_store.py:928), where every existing reason is a bare label ("another h2", "structured plan state"); the produced message is therefore "insert_section body must not contain follow-on" — the fragment is quoted, but the rule sentence is produced by nothing §4 names
